The '''Magar's World system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Stensen sector/Legends|Stensen sector]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC" /> that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Magar's World/Legends|Magar's World]].<ref name="Twitter" />
